title: Warning History Surcharge on Parking License Fines
content:
Community parking rules: warnings already issued on a Parking License add a surcharge to the scheduled fine.

## Rule

When two or more warnings were recorded on the license in the 12 months before the handling date, the warning surcharge is $10.00; when exactly one warning was recorded on the license in those months, the warning surcharge is $5.00; in every other case there is no warning surcharge. The warning surcharge is added to the scheduled fine.

A warning is a violation recorded on the license at the warning level.

## Surcharge by warnings on record

| Warnings recorded on the license in the 12 months before the handling date | Warning surcharge |
|---|---|
| two or more | $10.00 |
| exactly one | $5.00 |
| none | none |

## Illustrations (hypothetical histories)

- Warnings 2 and 9 months before the handling date: two warnings, $10.00.
- One warning 11 months before and one 13 months before: only one inside the 12 months, $5.00.
- A history of fines but no warning in the 12 months: no surcharge.
